bio: I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), where I lead the Smart City Research Group. I joined HKUST as an Assistant Professor in December 2019 and was appointed Associate Professor in July 2026. I earned my PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from The Ohio State University in 2017 and my bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from Zhejiang University in 2012. Before joining HKUST, I was a postdoctoral fellow at the University of California, Berkeley, working with Kameshwar Poolla and Pravin Varaiya.

I work on the theory and methods of control, optimization, machine learning, and reinforcement learning, with applications to transportation and power systems. I received the 2025 IEEE Transactions on Industry Applications Third Prize Paper Award, the 2020 O. Hugo Schuck Best Paper Award from the American Automatic Control Council, and the Best Student Paper Award at the 2020 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems. I was also a finalist for the Best Student Paper Award at the 2018 European Control Conference. I serve as an Associate Editor of IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, a Young Editorial Board Member of Communications in Transportation Research, and an Editorial Board Member of Transportmetrica A: Transport Science.
